headline: Argentine Household Loan Delinquency Drops as Bank Refinancings Increase
summary: A private banking report shows household default rates fell across major Argentine financial institutions, while overall lending remains stagnant and credit refinancings continue to expand.
why: Bank asset quality and consumer loan performance reflect economic adjustment and real wage trends under Argentina's macroeconomic austerity programs.

impacts.name: Argentine Banking
impacts.why: Reduced delinquency lowers immediate provisioning costs, but flat credit volumes limit loan margin expansion.
